requirements.rule: COMPORTO PROLUNGATO (art. 48): 274/411/548 days by seniority after one long continuous illness, two illnesses of 91 days or more, or an illness of 91 days or more running at the end of the comporto breve; the engine ends the comporto at the breve limit.
requirements.remediation: Model the comporto prolungato of art. 48 and its three triggers.

requirements.rule: WORK RULES (Art. 27, CCNL 2016 p. 104, unchanged by the renewals of 2021 and 2025): overtime 20% by day, 50% at night, 55% on a holiday and 75% on a holiday night beyond 8 hours, holiday work 55% and 10% with a compensatory rest day, for the workers not on shifts. Not modelled: the shift column (night overtime 40% for the first two hours and 45% after, holiday night 55% and 65%), the overtime with a compensatory rest day (35%, 55%), and the ordinary night work (25% to 22 o'clock, 35% after for the workers not on shifts).
requirements.remediation: Add a shift fact to the overtime event and the shift column of Art. 27, the compensatory-rest overtime and the ordinary night hours by the hour.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour follows the national CCNL rule on the hours of a day of leave (art. 32 c. 1-bis D.Lgs. 151/2001, work_rules.parental_hourly), or without one the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter: half the average daily hours a day, two such days a day of leave, no cumulation with the nursing rests on the same day (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.1-2.2). The run records this limitation while the bundle does not record the rule of the CCNL; a company or territorial agreement is the fact local_hourly_agreement of the event.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.
